checks.name: tenant operation key deduplicates producer requests durably
same producer key with changed payload is rejected
another tenant has an independent operation identity
boolean amount is rejected before enqueue
future scheduled work is ineligible until its due time
separate concurrent SQLite connections give one active job owner
expired lease rotates ownership and rejects old completion and failure
local business effect and job completion commit once together
failure between effect and done rolls both back then permits lease recovery
transient failure schedules capped backoff instead of immediate retry
permanent failure becomes terminal without an endless retry
abandoned leases eventually reach the configured attempt limit
committed job state and effect are visible through a new connection

scope: Real file-backed SQLite transactions and concurrent connections; logical lease clock, no managed queue or power-loss test
